privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Control who can see your profile and contact details.

visibilityExplain.public: Any signed-in user on the platform can view your public profile.
visibilityExplain.vinuni_only: Only the VinUni community (students, alumni, staff) can view your profile.
visibilityExplain.private: Only you can see it. Your profile won't appear in search or the talent pool.

privacy.contactIntro: Decide when recruiters can see your email and phone number.

contactExplain.public: Shown anywhere your profile is allowed to be seen.
contactExplain.invited: Only shown after you accept a reveal request or within an application.

privacy.openToWorkHelp: Let recruiters know you're open to new opportunities and which types.

validation.headlineMax: Headline must be at most 255 characters.
validation.summaryMax: Summary must be at most 5000 characters.
validation.phoneMax: Phone must be at most 30 characters.
validation.majorMax: Major must be at most 200 characters.
validation.endBeforeStart: End date must be after the start date.
validation.urlInvalid: Link must start with http:// or https://.
